info.title: Paceful ERS API
info.description:
The Paceful Emotional Readiness Score (ERS) API enables partners to integrate
emotional intelligence into their platforms. Measure emotional readiness across
5 clinical dimensions and get actionable insights.

## Authentication
All endpoints require an API key passed via the `Authorization` header as a Bearer token:
`Authorization: Bearer pk_live_your_key_here`.
Get your API key at [/partners/signup](/partners/signup).

## Rate Limiting
Rate limits are applied per API key. Check the `X-RateLimit-*` headers in responses:
- `X-RateLimit-Limit`: Maximum requests per window
- `X-RateLimit-Remaining`: Requests remaining in current window
- `X-RateLimit-Reset`: Unix timestamp when the window resets

## Sandbox Mode
Use a sandbox API key (prefix `pk_sandbox_`) for testing. Sandbox requests return
deterministic mock data and don't count against rate limits.

## ERS Dimensions
The ERS score is computed from 5 weighted dimensions:
- **Emotional Stability** (25%): Mood variance, regulation patterns
- **Self Reflection** (15%): Self-awareness, pattern recognition
- **Coping Capacity** (20%): Healthy coping strategies, problem-solving
- **Behavioral Engagement** (15%): Activity levels, routine consistency
- **Social Readiness** (25%): Openness to relationships, trust signals

post.description:
Submit answers to ERS assessment questions and receive a scored snapshot.

**Two modes:**
1. `action: "get_questions"` - Retrieve assessment questions
2. `action: "submit"` - Submit answers and get ERS score

Analyze unstructured text (journal entries, session notes, chat transcripts)
and extract ERS signals using AI. Returns dimensional scores with reasoning.

**Supported source types:**
- `journal` - Personal journal entries
- `session_notes` - Clinical/therapy session notes
- `chat_transcript` - Conversation transcripts
- `free_text` - General unstructured text

example.text:
Today was hard but I handled it better than I would have a few months ago.
When my plans got canceled, I caught myself before spiraling. I've been
doing breathing exercises and they actually help. I'm starting to recognize
my patterns and I think I'm ready to start putting myself out there again.

emotional_stability.label: moderate
emotional_stability.reasoning: Emotional stability indicators are moderate. Key signals: caught myself before spiraling and breathing exercises help.

self_reflection.label: high
self_reflection.reasoning: Self-reflection capacity indicators are strong. Key signals: recognize my patterns and handled it better than before.

coping_capacity.label: high
coping_capacity.reasoning: Coping capacity indicators are strong. Key signals: breathing exercises and they actually help.

behavioral_engagement.label: moderate
behavioral_engagement.reasoning: Behavioral engagement indicators are moderate. Key signals: putting myself out there.

social_readiness.label: moderate
social_readiness.reasoning: Social readiness indicators are moderate. Key signals: ready to start putting myself out there.

post.description:
Analyze multiple text entries and compute composite ERS scores with trends.
Useful for analyzing historical data or multiple users at once.

**Features:**
- Up to 20 entries per request
- Time-weighted composite scoring (recent entries weighted higher)
- Trend detection across entries
- Per-dimension trend analysis

entries.text: Feeling overwhelmed today. Couldn't focus at all.
Better today. Applied for that promotion I've been thinking about.
Great weekend hiking with friends. Felt present and happy.

post.description:
Run industry-specific signal detection alongside core ERS analysis.
Combines a full five-dimension ERS score with a vertical-specific signal catalog
and risk score.

**Available verticals:** `cx`, `dating`, `gambling`, `healthcare`, `insurance`

Use a sandbox key (`pk_sandbox_*`) for testing — returns deterministic mock data
without consuming rate limits.

example.text: I just need one more win to break even. I have been chasing my losses all week.

get.description:
Retrieve the current ERS score and dimensional breakdown for a user.
Returns the most recent calculated score with trend data.

**Authentication note:** This endpoint uses a separate B2B integration key system,
distinct from partner portal keys (`pk_live_*`). The key must have the `read_ers`
permission. Partner portal keys will return 403. Contact support to obtain a
B2B integration key with the required permission.

userId.name: userId
userId.description: External user ID (your system's user identifier)

answers.description: Question ID to answer (1-5 scale) mapping

text.description: Text to analyze (journal entry, session notes, etc.)

verbosity.description:
- `minimal`: Score and label only
- `standard`: Includes reasoning and signals
- `clinical`: Full detail with recommended actions

extraction_confidence.description: Duplicate of confidence — extraction quality indicator

welfare_flag.description:
Always present. True when the text contains language indicating potential
emotional risk beyond ordinary distress — hopelessness, expressions of not
wanting to exist, self-harm ideation, sustained emptiness, or feeling like
a burden. This is a human-escalation signal, not a clinical determination.
Do not act on it automatically. Route to a human reviewer.

welfare_note.description:
Empty string when welfare_flag is false. When true, contains a specific
description of what language triggered the flag. Suitable for inclusion
in a reviewer handoff note.

meta.description: Present when verbosity is standard or clinical

weekly_change.description: Score delta over prior 7 days; null if no prior data

reasoning.description: Present when verbosity is standard or clinical
